issues.title: TargetFramework needs upgrade from net6.0 to net8.0
issues.description: The project file specifies TargetFramework as net6.0, which must be updated to net8.0 for .NET 8 compatibility. This is the primary change required for upgrading to .NET 8.
issues.impact: Project now targets .NET 8 runtime and can use .NET 8 features and libraries
issues.remediation: Updated the TargetFramework element to net8.0 to enable .NET 8 compilation and runtime features

issues.title: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer version 6.0.25 needs upgrade
issues.description: ASP.NET Core authentication package is at version 6.0.25 and needs to be upgraded to 8.0.x for .NET 8 compatibility.
issues.impact: JWT authentication now uses .NET 8 compatible version with improved security and performance
issues.remediation: Updated package version to 8.0.0 for full .NET 8 compatibility

issues.title: Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore packages version 6.0.25 need upgrade
issues.description: Entity Framework Core packages (Design, InMemory, SqlServer) are at version 6.0.25 and need to be upgraded to 8.0.x for .NET 8 compatibility. EF Core 8 includes breaking changes in query behavior and model configuration.
issues.impact: All Entity Framework Core packages now use version 8.0.0 with improved query performance and new features
issues.remediation: Updated all three EF Core packages to version 8.0.0 to ensure consistency and compatibility

issues.title: Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Console version 6.0.0 needs upgrade
issues.description: Logging package is at version 6.0.0 and should be upgraded to 8.0.x for consistency and to leverage .NET 8 logging improvements.
issues.impact: Console logging now uses .NET 8 version with performance improvements
issues.remediation: Updated package version to 8.0.0 for consistency with other Microsoft packages

issues.title: Swashbuckle.AspNetCore version 6.4.0 may need upgrade
issues.description: Swagger/OpenAPI package is at version 6.4.0. While not directly version-coupled to .NET, upgrading to the latest version ensures compatibility with .NET 8 and ASP.NET Core 8 features.
issues.impact: Swagger/OpenAPI documentation generation now uses updated version with better .NET 8 support
issues.remediation: Updated to version 6.5.0 for improved compatibility and bug fixes

issues.title: System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt security vulnerability
issues.description: JWT token package had a known moderate severity vulnerability (GHSA-59j7-ghrg-fj52) and was causing package downgrade errors with .NET 8 dependencies.
issues.impact: Security vulnerability resolved and package version now compatible with .NET 8 dependencies
issues.remediation: Updated to version 8.0.0 to resolve security vulnerability and dependency conflicts

issues.title: WebApplicationBuilder pattern is correctly implemented
issues.description: The application uses the modern WebApplicationBuilder pattern with minimal hosting model, which is fully compatible with .NET 8. No changes required, but verified middleware order after package upgrades.
issues.impact: Verified that existing implementation is .NET 8 compatible
issues.remediation: No changes required - existing code is already compatible with .NET 8

issues.title: Insecure password hashing using SHA256
issues.description: The application uses SHA256 for password hashing without salt, which is not secure for password storage. While not a .NET 8 compatibility issue, this should be addressed during the upgrade.
issues.impact: Security recommendation noted but not required for .NET 8 upgrade
issues.remediation: Marked as future enhancement - recommend using BCrypt, Argon2, or PBKDF2

issues.title: DateTime.UtcNow usage throughout the application
issues.description: The application uses DateTime.UtcNow in multiple locations. While compatible with .NET 8, consider using the new TimeProvider abstraction for better testability and time zone handling.
issues.remediation: Marked as optional - existing code works fine with .NET 8

issues.title: Database.EnsureCreatedAsync usage in production code
issues.description: The application uses Database.EnsureCreatedAsync in the startup code. This is fine for development but not recommended for production. EF Core 8 has improved migration tooling.
issues.impact: Development/production parity concern, not a compatibility issue
issues.remediation: Marked as optional - existing code is compatible with .NET 8

issues.title: ImplicitUsings is already enabled
issues.description: The project already has ImplicitUsings enabled, which is excellent for .NET 8. No changes needed.

issues.title: Nullable reference types already enabled
issues.description: The project already has nullable reference types enabled, which provides better null safety and is fully compatible with .NET 8.

issues.title: String concatenation and collection operations could leverage .NET 8 improvements
issues.description: The application uses standard string operations and collections. .NET 8 introduces performance improvements with SearchValues, FrozenDictionary, and improved string handling.
issues.remediation: Marked as optional - existing code is compatible with .NET 8

issues.title: API settings and configuration are compatible
issues.description: The appsettings.json configuration format is fully compatible with .NET 8. No changes required.

recommendations: All critical and high-priority issues have been successfully fixed
